address: Stadhouderskade 25 (Park Centraal Amsterdam hotel and the MOMO corner), Amsterdam-Zuid: 1930 block with a stone-and-brick arched corner range on Stadhouderskade, a dark stone balcony range and a bowed hotel front with continuous glazed balconies
notes: Stadhouderskade 25 (BAG, built 1930; Park Centraal Amsterdam hotel sign on the north front, MOMO restaurant on the corner range) is a block on the Stadhouderskade with a bowed seven-storey hotel front with continuous glazed balcony runs, an older dark-stone corner range with white dressings and arched first-floor windows, and a dark stone balcony range on the south-west. 240 3DBAG wall surfaces; three fronts are drawn (w02-1, w04-1, w01-246), w03-157, w05-68 and w06-246 are close views of the same ranges and of the cream corner house; everything else stays blank.

walls[0] = surface 109 of panel 4 (N, 26.9 m, eaves 22.3; the 7.5 and 16.2 m end surfaces are left out because the eaves gate samples the lower roof): dark brick-grey skin, a glazed lobby ground storey (Park Centraal), six storeys of wide glazed windows with a glass-railed balcony run on each; drawn as 7 storeys x 8 bays. Simplified: the bowed plan (straight in 3DBAG), the rooftop crown and the oval roof sign, the lobby canopy lettering.

walls[1] = panel 5 (N, 20.3 m, eaves 17.8): the corner range: a brick ground with MOMO shopfronts, an arched first floor with white dressings and balcony rail, three upper storeys with white-surround windows and a cornice under dormers; drawn as 5 storeys x 5 bays, plinth-shopfront ground, round arched windows on storey 1, cornice. Simplified: the balcony rail on the arched storey (a balcony run would hide the arched heads in this kit), the stone dressings and dormers (3DBAG roof). walls[2] = surface 91 of panel 13 (SW, 31 m, eaves 17.3): dark stone block with shopfronts (PC BAGS, POV GALLERY) and balconies in every third bay on storeys 2-3; 5 storeys x 8 bays.
Not drawn: the cream corner house (w05-68, NE), the courtyard and the south front.
